adapter_principle: Every partner becomes a governed context surface; dAimon decides what future AI work may inherit from it.

partner_adapters.name: MongoDB
read_capabilities: read candidate/witness objects for exclusion reporting
write_capabilities: write Gemini returns as candidate objects
partner_adapters.authority_boundary: Writes remain candidate demo records unless settlement and receipt gates approve inheritance.
proof_obligations: Agent Builder or MCP trace for judged partner claim
partner_adapters.next_gate: Capture sample_outputs/agent_builder_mcp_trace.json from Agent Builder/MongoDB MCP execution.
non_claims: Complete MongoDB MCP production integration is not claimed until the Agent Builder trace is attached.
Vector search quality is not claimed by the current accepted-only retrieval proof.

partner_adapters.name: Arize
read_capabilities: read trace spans for dAimon runs
write_capabilities: write run metadata and evaluation labels
partner_adapters.authority_boundary: Observability explains behavior but does not by itself settle truth or authorize inheritance.
proof_obligations: trace receipt linking model call, retrieval, tool use, and settlement decision
evaluation result marked as advisory unless settled
partner_adapters.next_gate: Promote the Phoenix readiness trace into a run_live_vertical_slice.py trace fixture.
non_claims: Live Arize integration is not implemented.
Trace visibility is not the same as accepted state.

partner_adapters.name: Elastic
read_capabilities: retrieve rejected/deferred witness objects without making them inheritable
run filtered evidence discovery over claims and traces
partner_adapters.authority_boundary: Search can discover evidence; settlement decides whether evidence changes inheritance.
proof_obligations: exclusion proof showing rejected objects remain non-inheritable
partner_adapters.next_gate: Add a local Elastic adapter manifest fixture for receipt/evidence search.
non_claims: Live Elastic search integration is not implemented.
Search relevance is not proof of truth.

partner_adapters.name: GitLab
read_capabilities: read issue and merge request context
read CI and security scan status
write_capabilities: attach receipt links to SDLC artifacts
partner_adapters.authority_boundary: AI-generated SDLC actions remain candidate until project policy, CI, review, and receipt gates settle them.
proof_obligations: receipt linking AI action to code review outcome
partner_adapters.next_gate: Add GitLab issue/MR receipt fixture with no live mutation.
non_claims: Live GitLab integration is not implemented.
dAimon does not replace code review, CI, or security approval.

partner_adapters.name: Fivetran
write_capabilities: attach source freshness metadata to candidate context
partner_adapters.authority_boundary: Ingested enterprise data becomes witness or candidate context first; settlement controls inheritance.
partner_adapters.next_gate: Add Fivetran connector manifest fixture for enterprise ingestion.
non_claims: Live Fivetran integration is not implemented.
Ingestion does not make data automatically trusted or current.
